title: anthemis tinctoria subsp. fussii
intro: Anthemis tinctoria subsp. fussii, commonly known as German Chamomile, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the daisy family, characterized by its yellow-centered white flowers and apple-like fragrance. This plant has been used for its health benefits, including its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce anxiety and insomnia, and alleviate menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of German Chamomile include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its use in treating a variety of health conditions. The bioactive constituents of German Chamomile include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, such as chamazulene and apigenin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
